description: An understand run over every area of the python-inventory fixture, one reader task per area in code-map order: (root) reads main.py and answers two FEAT cards and an OQ card, inventory reads the db and stock modules and answers two BR cards and an INT card, sql reads the schema and answers an ENT card and tests reads its one test and answers no card. Every citation names lines of the fixture files. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called (P8-120).
